q: What makes up the carbon footprint of a television?
title: Television carbon footprint
short: For a TV, the display panel and electronics usually carry most of the manufacturing footprint, and electricity used over years of viewing can be larger still. Report assembly in Scope 1 and 2, bought panels and boards in Category 1, and use in Category 11.
audience: TV assemblers and brands in India

ul: Display panel and backlight, usually bought in.
Main board, power board and chips.
Plastic or metal housing, stand and packaging.

p: Estimate use as rated power × hours a day × days × years, using a stated grid factor. State your assumptions, because hours of viewing change the result a lot.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
